about.title: About me
about.text: I am a Full-Stack Developer based in Leipzig, Germany. After a decade in logistics I went back to school, earned a Master's in Medical Physics and first got into programming with Python for data analysis. For the past two years I have been working as a developer full time, and alongside that I build websites for businesses end to end, from front-end to back-end. Claude Code and agentic workflows are part of my everyday work.

angular.title: Angular development in Leipzig
angular.description: Angular developer from Leipzig: web applications with Angular, TypeScript and SSR, from component to deployment.
angular.intro: Angular is my daily tool, at work and in my own projects. I use it to build applications that stay maintainable for years: clear component structure, typed interfaces, tests where they catch something.

sections.p: Internal tools, customer portals, dashboards and web apps that run in the browser and as an app on the phone. A current example is traudel.app, a neighbourhood app whose front end is built in Angular and shipped to the app stores via Capacitor.
Standalone components, signals, strict typing and server-side rendering where load time and discoverability matter. This site is an example: Angular 21 with SSR, prerendered, no trackers.
I also take over grown Angular projects: upgrades to current versions, moving to standalone and signals, performance and accessibility reviews, test coverage where it hurts.

python.title: Python back-end development
python.seoTitle: Python back-end development Leipzig – Philipp Wendschuch
python.description: Back-end development with Python from Leipzig: REST APIs with FastAPI, Django and Flask, databases, Docker and CI/CD.
python.intro: Python is where I started programming, back then for data analysis during my medical physics degree. Today I use it for the interfaces and data models behind web applications.

sections.p: REST APIs with FastAPI or Django, properly documented, with validation and tests. Database schemas that fit the product, and migrations you still understand a year later. PL/SQL is part of my daily work.

Docker images that build reproducibly, CI/CD pipelines that run tests and deployments, and logging that actually helps when something breaks. I do not hand over an application that only runs on my machine.
Because I build both sides, API and interface fit together: no fields nobody needs, no endpoints queried three times.

websites.title: Websites for businesses in Leipzig
websites.seoTitle: Websites for businesses Leipzig – Philipp Wendschuch
websites.description: Websites for businesses, practices and service providers in Leipzig: fast, GDPR-compliant, accessible, with ongoing care. Together with Webwerk Leipzig.
websites.intro: A website has to be found, load fast and work on the phone. Everything else is decoration. I build sites that do these three things reliably, and I keep them that way afterwards.

sections.p: Concept and copy together with you, design, implementation without heavyweight page builders, legal pages, a contact form with spam protection, Google Business integration. Hosting and ongoing maintenance on request.
Hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript or Angular, depending on the need. Self-hosted fonts, no trackers without consent, load times under a second, accessibility to WCAG.
For trades, restaurants and small businesses I work with Andreas Kunisch under the name Webwerk Leipzig. There you get fixed packages with clear prices, one-off or as a care plan.

ai.title: AI-assisted software development
ai.description: Software development with Claude Code and agentic workflows: deliver faster without giving up control over quality and architecture.
ai.intro: I have worked with Claude Code every day for more than a year. Not as autocomplete, but as a tool that implements tasks from a specification while I keep architecture, review and decisions.

sections.h: What it looks like in practice
sections.p: A task is first broken down into a specification and a plan. Then agents implement the steps, with tests. I review every step before it goes into the main branch. The result is faster than by hand and cleaner than waving things through.
Migrations and upgrades, test coverage for existing code, prototypes that stand in days instead of weeks, recurring routine work such as forms, interfaces and documentation.
Security-relevant code, data protection and everything a person has to answer for is read and understood by me before it runs. AI speeds up the work, the responsibility stays with me.
